blocks.title: Iteration
blocks.text: Iteration ka matlab matlooba nateeje ke qareeb pohanchne ke liye amal dohrana hai, raye ki bunyad par tabdeeli karte hue jab tak aakhri nateeja na mile, jaise bawarchi khana chakh chakh kar theek karta hai.
School event ka logo banana: pehla design share karein, hum jamaaton ki raye se rang aur shaklein badlein, phir poochein aur sab ki manzoori tak nikharein.

blocks.alt: Chaar dabbe ek chakkar mein: 1. Design (logo banayein ya badlein) -> 2. Share karein (hum jamaaton ko dikhayein) -> 3. Raye (feedback): rang aur shaklein kaisi? -> 4. Behtar karein (refine): tabdeeli karein -> wapas 1. Beech mein: sab ki manzoori tak dohrayein.
blocks.caption: Iteration ka chakkar: school event ke logo ki misal (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Class activity: groups poster bana kar doosre group se raye ke liye badalte, behtar karte aur naya version share karte hain. Is mein iteration kaunsa hissa hai?
blocks.explanation: Doosre group ki raye se poster badalna aur behtar version share karna.
